newsitem.title: USA: Burson-Marsteller to close Swiss buy April 15.
newsitem.headline: Burson-Marsteller to close Swiss buy April 15.

text.p: Public relations firm Burson-Marsteller said Thursday it expects to close on its acquisition of Jaeggi Communications on April 15.
Jaeggi Communications, a full-service public relations and advertising firm, has operations in Bern and Zurich.
With the completion of the acquisition, these companies will be renamed Jaeggi-Burson-Marsteller Bern AG and Jaeggi-Burson-Marsteller Zurich AG.
Jaeggi employs 35 professionals and has gross revenues of about $7.2 million.
The management of Jaeggi Communications will retain a minority shareholding in the Jaeggi-Burson-Marsteller operations, the company said.
The company did not release details of the transaction.
